SELECT s.id, s.class_id AS classId, s.lesson_date AS lessonDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.class_name, ''), cg.name) AS className, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.course_name, ''), c.name) AS courseName, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.teacher_name, ''), t.name) AS teacherName, s.room, s.lesson_mode AS lessonMode, s.status, s.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, s.should_count AS shouldCount, s.actual_count AS actualCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance a WHERE a.schedule_id = s.id) AS recordCount FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = s.class_id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = s.teacher_id LEFT JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = s.campus_id
AND s.lesson_date = #{date} AND s.lesson_date < #{today} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attendance ax WHERE ax.schedule_id = s.id)
AND s.campus_id = #{campusId} AND s.room = #{room} AND s.lesson_mode = #{lessonMode} AND s.course_id = #{courseId} AND s.teacher_name = #{teacher} AND (s.class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.room LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.teacher_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attendance ar WHERE ar.schedule_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attendance an WHERE an.schedule_id = s.id)
ORDER BY s.lesson_date DESC, s.start_time ASC

SELECT cs.student_id AS studentId, st.name AS studentName, cs.status AS studentStatus, e.id AS enrollmentId, c.name AS courseName, e.remain_lessons AS remainLessons, e.unit_price AS unitPrice, a.status AS recordStatus, a.lessons AS recordLessons, a.remark AS recordRemark FROM class_student cs JOIN student st ON st.id = cs.student_id LEFT JOIN enrollment e ON e.id = ( SELECT e2.id FROM enrollment e2 WHERE e2.student_id = cs.student_id AND e2.status = '生效' ORDER BY (e2.class_id = #{classId}) DESC, e2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = e.course_id LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND a.student_id = cs.student_id WHERE cs.class_id = #{classId} AND cs.status = '在读' ORDER BY st.name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance (campus_id, schedule_id, class_id, student_id, enrollment_id, teacher_id, lesson_date, lessons, status, checked_at, remark) VALUES (#{campusId}, #{scheduleId}, #{classId}, #{studentId}, #{enrollmentId}, #{teacherId}, #{lessonDate}, #{lessons}, #{status}, #{checkedAt}, #{remark})
